My name is Bibi Shoby. I am from Kothamangalam. This is my husband Shoby. Last year in March, we found out that he has cancer. We went to a prominent hospital in Ernakulam,
and when we went there, the doctors said it was the early stage of cancer. At that time, after four chemo sessions, a surgery was also performed. After that, the doctor said he would
be completely cured of the disease. We went ahead in peace, believing that there would be no problems of any kind after the surgery. During that surgery,
every moment was going through critical stages. The surgery, which was said to take eight hours, extended to twelve hours. Everyone was very fearful, and the power of prayer was also increasing. At that time,
I called a sister whom I usually call whenever I face sorrows. She told me to go to
Kreupasanam and take the covenant immediately. She said, if I do that, everything would be fine. But I said,
I don’t know how to go to Kreupasanam, and I wouldn’t get permission from my home. So I said I will not do anything like that. After the surgery
was over, we came home. After two or three days, a brother came and handed me the Kreupasanam paper. Then I said, I don’t want
this paper because I do not have faith in it, and also, since I have children, it would be difficult to keep it safely. That is why I said I don’t want the paper.
I sent that brother back. After that, he went through another four chemo sessions, and a PET scan was done. There were no problems, but when we went for a follow-up,
unexpectedly, cancer cells were found again in his body. None of us had expected this. We all were…
We were in a state of not knowing what to do. The doctor said that now no surgery could be done, and chemo was our only option. During that time,
my husband’s daughter, my little niece, told me, “Baby, let’s go to Kreupasanam.” Then I heard about Kreupasanam again. I did not think much about it. Then, for life going forward,
there seemed to be no way ahead. Hearing what the doctors said, I immediately came here on January 23 and took the covenant. For such a long time, I had been praying in the Jacobite church.
I was born and brought up there, and I considered myself a devoted believer. I prayed well, went to church, read the Bible, did everything, but the true
meaning of prayer, how to pray to the Mother and God, and how to walk on the path of faith—I learned all of this only when I came to Kreupasanam.
For so long, I kept saying, “children, children,” and never had time to walk and pray. Now, prayer is the only thing I have time for. That’s how, again,
after the surgery, he went through chemo again. When we went for a follow-up, the doctor said, and at the visit,
cancer cells were found again. Then the doctor told me there was nothing more to be done; we could only do chemo.
So he went through four chemo sessions. I took the covenant, prayed, and every day, first thing, I took the covenant here. When I went home,
I would mix blessed salt in porridge, sprinkle it, and give it to him. But my husband was very
angry with me. He said he did not need any of this, he did not believe in any of it.
I then told him, he needs to believe, but if the Mother blesses me to give testimony at the altar of Kreupasanam, then he would come with me.
Since then until today, he has taken the covenant oil and made the sign of the cross on his forehead and chest every day.
After reciting the faith prayer, the Our Father, and the Hail Mary, and praying every day, only then would we rest. Later, after four more chemo sessions, a PET scan
date was given. I started praying from that date. Two days before the PET scan, I felt in my
heart that I should go to Father Joseph to receive a blessing. Then, even though the surgery was done,
I was afraid whether my husband could come. Still, when I asked, for some reason, he did not raise any objections. He came here, saw his father, and prayed. Even then, he came
only following my insistence. He did not even place the covenant medal from his father on the garland; he kept it in his purse. After his father prayed, placing his hand on his head,
my husband returned without faith. At that moment, when I saw his father here, I truly received the fragrance
of jasmine flowers. I remembered, “God, where is this coming from?” When I heard all these testimonies and prayers,
I saw a rainbow and smelled the fragrance of jasmine flowers. Then I thought, my Mother is near
me. Whatever happens with my husband, my Mother will comfort him. Now I have nothing to fear. Then I
prayed from in front of this altar, in the altar of Kreupasanam, and testified to the world that my husband’s
cancer would be completely cured. Similarly, after completing twelve chemo sessions, just before the PET scan, I brought my husband near
and he testified with complete faith. I also told him, “We can go together.” I brought him near his father and told him to say a
word to his father. Until then, he had said nothing. He said to his father, “Father, my PET scan is on the 25th. Will you pray?”
His father prayed, applied covenant oil on his chest, prayed, and blessed him. From that moment, I was certain that nothing could go wrong anymore.
On the 27th, the results came. The PET scan report confirmed that the cancer, that dreadful disease, had completely disappeared from my husband’s body.
That was not all. One day, the doctor who had been monitoring us called me privately and said that Shobi would remain with him for about six or eight months.
I thought to myself that I must move forward with hope. That morning, I said, “A miracle will happen. No
matter what, my Mother will not let go of me,” and I held the doctor’s hand and gave my word.
That word, that prayer, my Mother’s protection, and her care for my family—today I stand here in full health, without any problems.
Today, to give this testimony, I came to this altar. Even when I came here, I faced obstacles, but seeing my Mother’s tears,
I went to the altar, lifting my Mother’s image in my hands. I was able to renew my covenant. In my
life, nothing bad will happen anymore. We have a strong faith that my Mother will protect our family and my husband.
Our family now has a firm belief that my Mother will protect us. I, who had once refused to believe in Kreupasanam, now
testify that Shobi, who had rejected Kreupasanam, has taken a covenant to testify. I can say to the people that today I came,
held my father’s feet, and I can tell the world that my Mother restored my husband to me as before. Thank you, Mother.
A thousand, a thousand, a thousand thanks. A billion thanks. No one who comes here should leave upset. Whatever happens, my Mother will protect and take care of us.
As I said in my covenant, all prayers, all good deeds, and the salary I receive, I have not used for anything else before this. I have used it
only to buy some bakery items for my children, household necessities, and a dress for myself. Today, I am ready to do acts of charity.
I ran to visit orphanages and everywhere I went. I thought, who really needs me? Who really needs me? I took the Kreupasanam paper and went. I didn’t care about the rain or the sun.
I went even among Muslims. I went wherever I wanted. I visited anyone, and it was with the Mother’s paper from
Kreupasanam. That day, I testified that my husband’s cancer, that dreadful disease, had completely been removed from his body by Mother.
I am a witness standing before you all. I told everyone I met about this. By the power of Mother at Kreupasanam,
by the power of my Jesus, my husband stands here today without any problems. Even standing before the altar, Mother,
there were many obstacles trying to harm me, but overcoming all difficulties, hearing my Mother’s prayers, I joined with my Mother and said what I am saying. I am not speaking;
it is my Mother speaking through this incapable person. Everyone here is shedding tears. Has everyone prayed with tears? The living Mother, the living
Mother is here. You do not need to run anywhere else abandoning this Mother. Thank You, Jesus. Thank You, Mother. I could speak just two words and held my husband’s hand.
What my wife said is 100% true. I myself did not believe that my illness would be cured. I did not believe that my disease would go away because I
am technical and had researched a lot. The second occurrence was the same cells, and it was in the lymph nodes. Therefore, surgically, there was no other option.
Since the HR was negative, we couldn’t do immunotherapy or any other therapy.
The only option was chemotherapy. Until then, I had strong faith as I mentioned. Amit had no faith, but Bibi came to Kreupasanam, received the oil, and last time when I came here
I lay down there. I thought in my mind, Mother, after my PET scan and once this illness is gone, I will come and testify here. I said this, and it happened.
I am immensely thankful to Mother. Thank You. Psalm 34, from verse 5 to 7, as those who read there saw, will be enlightened; they will not be ashamed.
The humble cried out, the Lord heard, and saved him from all troubles. The Lord’s angel encamps around the devout and rescues them.
This sister Bibi Shobi, life partner, regained life from the brink of death and joyfully testifies at the holy feet of Mother Kreupasanam.
She testifies to great health. Thank You. Dear friends, this is a beautiful testimony of faith that Bibi shared at this altar. Everything was broken; life
had been lost, the marriage broken, the family disrupted, the disease destroying the household. But from that point, life, her life partner, family, faith,
and God’s love were restored. This is a testimony of a daughter’s great journey shared at this altar. To Mother, Father, and Holy Mary, we give thanks for these great divine experiences
and with folded hands, let us offer this testimony. For unprecedented divine experiences, if you haven’t subscribed to this YouTube channel yet, subscribe now.
